capabilities: Log workouts by clicking dates in an interactive monthly calendar
Search and autocomplete from a 1,300+ exercise database
Build and reorder reusable workout templates with drag-and-drop
Auto-fill sets, reps, and weights from the previous session
Save all data to a single JSON-backed file or plugin settings
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the exercise database comes from an external third-party dataset.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to track workouts, and logging them as notes would clutter the vault with many files or require outside fitness apps.
summary: Gym workout logger with a monthly calendar, 1,300+ exercise database, reusable templates, and last-session auto-fill, storing all data in one file.
